//: Three-role commit gate for ML experiments. Deterministic checks run first and are the only thing that can APPROVE; the scope check, the dangling reference check and the decision record check (integrity/integrity.py gate / refs / record, config scope, refs and record sections) and then the adversary run last, in that order, only if they all passed (skip_if_failed); the adversary can only VETO (exit 3). Tokens: __PY__ = the supervisor's Python, __HARNESS__ = engine/, the folder holding run_issues.py / ml_gate.py / adversary.py, __PROJECT_CONFIG__ = the project's issue-automation.config.json (its ml/adversary sections). Commands run with the repo as cwd.

suspicious.//: Model weights, datasets and run artifacts never get committed (gitignore data/, results/, models/); the ledger does. Top-level data/ only, so a src/data/ package is fine; max_file_mb catches stray big files.

always.label: ML gate (deterministic: protected eval/data, results contract, plausibility, improvement)

commands.label: unit tests (pytest; passes when the repo has none yet)
argv:
import importlib.util,subprocess,sys
if importlib.util.find_spec('pytest') is None: sys.exit(0)
r=subprocess.call([sys.executable,'-m','pytest','-q'])
sys.exit(0 if r==5 else r)
